tests.name: live

tests.name: live_check

tests.previous_reason: Broad qualification or diagnostic entry point. Its original implementation is commented and the callable refuses, so disabled checks cannot yield a passing release claim.

tests.name: test_every_retired_selector_refuses_and_preserves_history
tests.reason: Exercises retired subscription routes through real driver processes and independently rereads stored historical conversation bytes. Guards destructive reuse/removal of legacy accounts after the provider cutover; ordinary parser predicates do not observe preserved state.

tests.name: test_incomplete_concurrent_creation_is_not_a_sign_in_to_recover

tests.description: Incomplete concurrent creation is not a sign in to recover.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: incomplete concurrent creation is not a sign in to recover. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_golden_histories_and_every_incremental_snapshot

tests.name: test_a_group_that_has_exited_but_is_not_reaped_is_ending

tests.name: test_private_atomic_state_and_newer_format_is_untouched

tests.name: test_recovery_never_deletes_or_overwrites_a_newer_run
tests.reason: Replaces a run while its stale recovery is awaiting cleanup, in both success and failure paths. The newer record and its evidence must survive; a simple sequential recovery test cannot establish this.

tests.name: test_subscriptions_late_check_and_usage_cannot_overwrite_newer_state
tests.reason: Persists sign-in state, replaces it, then applies a stale run report and rereads the current record. Protects newer sign-out/label state from late credential/usage responses; top-tier run-record recovery addresses a different store and operation.
tests.description: Subscriptions late check and usage cannot overwrite newer state.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: subscriptions late check and usage cannot overwrite newer state. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_legacy_split_surrogate_map_rebuilds_safely
tests.reason: Seeds an actual legacy continuity map with the old runtime surrogate digest and reserves against current history. Confirms safe rebuild rather than invalid resume; pure golden fingerprints do not test the filesystem migration decision.
tests.description: Legacy split surrogate map rebuilds safely.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: legacy split surrogate map rebuilds safely. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_generated_python_helper_quotes_spaced_interpreter_and_arguments
tests.reason: Executes a generated shell helper through a symlinked interpreter with spaces/quotes and compares literal argv. Detects broken launch or shell reinterpretation across generation and execution, not merely shell-source formatting.
tests.description: Generated python helper quotes spaced interpreter and arguments.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: generated python helper quotes spaced interpreter and arguments. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_child_command_drains_stderr_and_honors_cancel
tests.reason: Runs a real child that exceeds pipe capacity and then a cancellable sleeper. Observes completion and bounded cancellation; the top-tier blocked-output case covers the driver output pipe, not child stderr draining.
tests.description: Child command drains stderr and honors cancel.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: child command drains stderr and honors cancel. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_detached_pipe_holder_cannot_keep_command_alive
tests.reason: A detached grandchild inherits pipes after its parent exits; measures command completion despite the surviving pipe owner. Covers a distinct subprocess-lifetime hang that ordinary cancellation cannot simulate.
tests.description: Detached pipe holder cannot keep command alive.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: detached pipe holder cannot keep command alive. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_output_backpressure_uses_one_absolute_stop_deadline
tests.reason: Fills a real unread pipe, starts stopping, and requires the blocked write to end under one absolute deadline with cancellation signalled. Exposes shutdown hangs caused by blocked output.

tests.name: test_secret_command_fresh_environment_and_single_newline
tests.reason: Executes an actual rotating credential command, observes fresh reads and child environment isolation, then checks failed-command output is withheld. Covers credential subprocess behavior beyond the static environment allowlist.
tests.description: Secret command fresh environment and single newline.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: secret command fresh environment and single newline. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_error_fields_override_wording_and_usage_never_double_counts
tests.reason: Feeds a streaming usage sequence followed by authoritative final totals and observes accumulated usage/events. Detects billing double-counting and subscription-cost leakage across state transitions; individual quota field mappings do not establish this invariant.
